summary: Completed comprehensive testing of TWAS REPAIR unified app with local report API. All backend APIs (16/16 tests passed) and core frontend features working correctly. Supervisor dashboard shows unified list of timesheets and reports with Criar Novo button and modal with 3 options. Report creation, editing, and PDF generation all functional. Admin dashboard has proper cards for service/daily reports.

ui_bugs.issue: router.back() warning on save - 'GO_BACK action was not handled' - but save works correctly

issues: Console warnings about deprecated 'shadow*' style props - should use 'boxShadow' instead

action_items: LOW: Fix router.back() navigation warning in edit-report.tsx - consider using router.push('/supervisor') instead
critical_code_review_comments: Report API CRUD operations all working correctly with MongoDB backend
PDF generation for reports working - produces valid PDF documents
Unified supervisor dashboard correctly shows both timesheets and reports with distinct badges
OS dropdown in create-report correctly loads from local service-orders API
Edit report page has all 7 editable sections (periodo, executado_por, introduction, equipment, objective, service_description, observations)
seed_data_creation: None - used existing data from database
context_for_next_testing_agent: All unified app features working. Local report API replaces external API. Edit-report page has a minor GO_BACK navigation warning but saves correctly. The unified dashboard shows timesheets (clock icon) and reports (wrench/calendar icons) with proper badges. PDF generation works for both timesheets and reports.
